title: Solidity — Final Mastery Assessment

outcomes: Test failure paths, fuzz cases, and invariants

question_distribution.area: Gas, deployment, upgrades, and professional practice
outcomes: Reproduce builds and document release assumptions

remediation: Review the relevant module, complete its exercise, and retake with a new randomized variant after addressing identified gaps. Passing the assessment is not a smart-contract security certification.
certificate_policy: A certificate may only be issued after the platform backend has verified the passing exam attempt; this course package does not issue certificates.
